title: Heber J. Grant
callings: Presidents of the Quorum of the Twelve
vital_facts: Ordained a Seventy 1871 at age of fifteen!
Married Lucy Stringham 1877, six children; later practiced plural marriage
Ordained Apostle and called to the Twelve 1882
Opened and Presided over Japanese Mission 1901-1903
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
